title: Ribbon Acquisition Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-15
summary: Ribbon Acquisition Corp., a SPAC (Special Purpose Acquisition Company) incorporated in the Cayman Islands and listed on Nasdaq (tickers: RIBB, RIBBU, RIBBR), filed an 8-K on April 14, 2026 announcing a $125,000 deposit into its trust account for a one-month extension of its deadline to consummate an initial business combination. The extension was approved by shareholders pursuant to previously approved Extension Amendment and Trust Amendment provisions.
